title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ServiceSpecification
description: ServiceSpecification is a class that offers characteristics to describe a type of service. Functionally, it acts as a template by which Services may be instantiated. By sharing the same specification, these services would therefore share the same set of characteristics. (TM Forum TMF633 Service Catalog Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition ServiceSpecification; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceSpecification:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ServiceSpecification'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceSpecification:<tmfId>. Unique identifier of the service specification

href.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/href'. Reference of the service specification

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/description'. A narrative that explains in detail what the service specification is

isBundle.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/isBundle'. isBundle determines whether a ServiceSpecification represents a single ServiceSpecification (false), or a bundle of ServiceSpecification (true).

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/lastUpdate'. Date and time of the last update of the service specification

lifecycleStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/lifecycleStatus'. Used to indicate the current lifecycle status of the service specification

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/name'. Name of the service specification

attachment.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/attachment'. A list of attachments (Attachment [*]). Complements the description of the specification through video, pictures...

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/relatedParty'. A list of related party references (RelatedParty [*]). A related party defines party or party role linked to a specific entity.

resourceSpecification.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/resourceSpecification'. A list of resource specification references (ResourceSpecificationRef [*]). The ResourceSpecification is required for a service specification with type ResourceFacingServiceSpecification (RFSS). In TMF this is an array of ResourceSpecificationRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced ResourceSpecification entities (urn:ngsi-ld:ResourceSpecification:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

serviceLevelSpecification.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/serviceLevelSpecification'. A list of service level specifications related to this service specification, and which will need to be satisifiable for corresponding service instances; e.g. Gold, Platinum. In TMF this is an array of ServiceLevelSpecificationRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced ServiceLevelSpecification entities (urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceLevelSpecification:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

serviceSpecCharacteristic.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/serviceSpecCharacteristic'. A list of service spec characteristics (ServiceSpecCharacteristic [*]). This class represents the key features of this service specification.

serviceSpecRelationship.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/serviceSpecRelationship'. A list of service specifications related to this specification, e.g. migration, substitution, dependency or exclusivity relationship

targetServiceSchema.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/targetServiceSchema'. A target service schema reference (TargetServiceSchemaRef). The reference object to the schema and type of target service which is described by service specification.

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/validFor'. The period for which the service specification is valid

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceSpecification/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'ServiceSpecification' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class entity name

ServiceSpecCharacteristic.description: This class represents the key features of this service specification. For example, bandwidth is a characteristic of many different types of services; if bandwidth is a relevant characteristic (e.g., from the point-of-view of a Customer obtaining this Service via a Product) then bandwidth would be a ServiceSpecCharacteristic for that particular Service.

configurable.description: If true, the Boolean indicates that the serviceSpecCharacteristic is configurable

description.description: A narrative that explains in detail what the serviceSpecCharacteristic is

extensible.description: An indicator that specifies that the values for the characteristic can be extended by adding new values when instantiating a characteristic for an Entity.

isUnique.description: An indicator that specifies if a value is unique for the specification. Possible values are; "unique while value is in effect" and "unique whether value is in effect or not"

maxCardinality.description: The maximum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on. For example, zero to five phone numbers in a group calling plan, where five is the value for the maxCardinality.

minCardinality.description: The minimum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on. For example, zero to five phone numbers in a group calling plan, where zero is the value for the minCardinality.

name.description: A word, term, or phrase by which this characteristic specification is known and distinguished from other characteristic specifications.

regex.description: A rule or principle represented in regular expression used to derive the value of a characteristic value.

valueType.description: A kind of value that the characteristic can take on, such as numeric, text and so forth

serviceSpecCharRelationship.description: A list of service spec char relationships (ServiceSpecCharRelationship [*]). An aggregation, migration, substitution, dependency or exclusivity relationship between/among Specification Characteristics.

serviceSpecCharacteristicValue.description: A list of service spec characteristic values (ServiceSpecCharacteristicValue [*]). A ServiceSpecCharacteristicValue object is used to define a set of attributes, each of which can be assigned to a corresponding set of attributes in a ServiceSpecCharacteristic object. The values of the attributes in the ServiceSpecCharacteristicValue object describe the values of the attributes that a corresponding ServiceSpecCharacteristic object can take on.

validFor.description: The period for which the serviceSpecCharacteristic is valid

ServiceSpecCharacteristicValue.description: A ServiceSpecCharacteristicValue object is used to define a set of attributes, each of which can be assigned to a corresponding set of attributes in a ServiceSpecCharacteristic object. The values of the attributes in the ServiceSpecCharacteristicValue object describe the values of the attributes that a corresponding ServiceSpecCharacteristic object can take on.

isDefault.description: Indicates if the value is the default value for a characteristic

rangeInterval.description: An indicator that specifies the inclusion or exclusion of the valueFrom and valueTo attributes. If applicable, possible values are "open", "closed", "closedBottom" and "closedTop".

regex.description: A regular expression constraint for given value

unitOfMeasure.description: A length, surface, volume, dry measure, liquid measure, money, weight, time, and the like. In general, a determinate quantity or magnitude of the kind designated, taken as a standard of comparison for others of the same kind, in assigning to them numerical values, as 1 foot, 1 yard, 1 mile, 1 square foot.

valueFrom.description: The low range value that a characteristic can take on

valueTo.description: The upper range value that a characteristic can take on

valueType.description: A kind of value that the characteristic can take on, such as numeric, text, and so forth

validFor.description: The period of time for which a value is applicable

value.description: A discrete value that the characteristic can take on, or the actual value of the characteristic
